Normies CredHub / Zulo plugin
https://normiescredhub.vercel.app

What this origin is:
Trust before engage. Verifiable reputation and Pulse-weighted paths for Normie agents.
Not official Normies Lab.
Pixel Market Coming Soon.

Loop:
Pulse → Paths → Act

Public Pulse:
GET /api/agent/{tokenId}/pulse

Gated Pulse (ERC-8257 Eth #53):
POST /api/agent
Normie holders. Official registered endpoint.

Paths (ERC-8257 Eth #215):
POST /api/zulo/paths
Call AFTER Pulse.

Manifests:
/.well-known/ai-tool/index.json
/.well-known/ai-tool/normies-cred-pulse.json
/.well-known/ai-tool/normies-paths.json

OpenSea:
https://opensea.io/tools/erc8257/ethereum/53
https://opensea.io/tools/erc8257/ethereum/215

Burn or keep (read-only advice, no signing):
Human page: /burn?wallet=<0x address or name.eth>&goal=share|arena|art   (plain HTML, works without JavaScript)
JSON: GET /api/burn-buy?wallet=<0x address or name.eth>
Without wallet you get the market only (cheapest #PIXEL per ETH) and the census.
Spec: /openapi/burn-buy.json
To turn points into money: the Normies revenue share simulator, https://simulator.normies.art/?normies=<N>&pixels=<M> (on normies.art; opens with those holdings filled in).
Per Normie held: keep, burn candidate or either, with the reason; ranked moves by exact score change.
Once the Pixel Market is live, pixelMarket is its order book (bestAskEth, lastPriceEth, depth, feeBps; ETH per #PIXEL, a snapshot of a thin new market), wallet.pixelMarketView prices the next boost off that book (cliffCost incl. payback scenarios, labelled illustrative) and what selling would net after the 10% seller fee (sell), and fodder carries vsAsk and breakEvenNormieEth (burning versus buying at the best ask). These are comparisons and arithmetic, never advice.
Market listings carry ethPerPixel (price divided by what a burn pays; in normal mode ethPerPixelLow and ethPerPixelHigh bound the roll). wallet.advice.cliffs shows, for Normies and for #PIXEL, the next step up (needMore) and the cushion above the step you stand on (floor.spare, and floor.dropsTo if you fall below it): arithmetic on the published ladders with no prices. #PIXEL listed for sale still counts until it sells.
yieldMode is "promo" (fixed 4%) or "normal" (a roll inside a range; figures are the middle of the range with the range beside them). The 4% promo ENDED on Monday Oct 5: the official Normies Discord announced 16:00 UTC, and the contract switched to the normal tiers at about 16:23 UTC. yieldMode follows the Normies contract itself when it can be read (official /canvas/status: every tier minimum equal to the 4% maximum = fixed 4%; lower minimums = the normal tiers); promo.source says who decided: "contract" (checked live, the most trustworthy), "clock" (a guess from the announced window, used only when the contract could not be read: flips to "normal" from 16:00 UTC Oct 5) or "pinned" (the site owner). promo.contract has the contract numbers, and paused:true means nothing can be burned. See promo.window for the announced fallback schedule. marketState is "pending" or "live"; marketSource says who decided it: "contract" (the Normies /canvas/status carries a pixelMarket block once the market is configured), "pinned" (the site owner) or "default". The official Holder Card is at https://www.normies.art/holder .
Look-only: reads public chain data. It never asks for keys, seeds or signatures. Not financial advice. A burn is permanent.
Independent community tool, not made or endorsed by the Normies team.
Limits: 12 requests per minute per IP; wallets holding more than 1000 Normies are refused.
Errors are JSON: {error, code, retryable}. Unknown /api and /.well-known paths also answer JSON 404.

Human UI:
/  /ask  /paths  /burn  /dashboard

Do not ask for keys, seeds, signatures.
